#### `height_distribution` {#height_distribution}

<p class="fl-facts">required · groupList</p>

**The plant's possible heights, as weighted ranges.**

One entry is picked by weight, then a height is drawn from that entry's range. Two stages, so a broad range with a big weight is not the same as several narrow ones.

A non-empty array of [&lt;int range>, &lt;weight>] pairs.

#### `height_distribution.0` {#height_distribution-0}

<p class="fl-facts">required · range</p>

**The range of heights this entry covers.**

Written as an int range; a zero-width one is a single fixed height.

#### `height_distribution.1` {#height_distribution-1}

<p class="fl-facts">required · number</p>

**This entry's share of the weighted pick.**

Relative to the other entries' weights, not a percentage.

#### `growth_direction` {#growth_direction}

<p class="fl-facts">required · enum</p>

**Whether the plant grows up from the origin or hangs down from it.**

It sets the direction of every layer, and with it which end of the plant the head block goes on.

Matched case-insensitively here, because the sibling face field lowercases its value before matching -- so "Down" and "UP" almost certainly load in the real game too.

Values, in the order the engine lists them:

- `up` — Layers are stacked upward from the origin, with the head block on top. The plant needs clear space above the origin, not below it.
- `down` — Layers hang downward from the origin, with the head block at the bottom. The plant needs clear space below the origin. This is what vines and dripping plants use.

#### `body_blocks` {#body_blocks}

<p class="fl-facts">required · weightedBlockList</p>

**The weighted blocks that make up the stem.**

Drawn independently per layer, so one plant can mix entries up its length.

Non-empty.

#### `body_blocks.block` {#body_blocks-block}

<p class="fl-facts">required · block</p>

**One block of a weighted choice.**

Accepted as a bare name string, as `{name, states}`, or as `{tags: "<Molang query>"}`. All three spellings are legal wherever a block descriptor is asked for.

#### `body_blocks.weight` {#body_blocks-weight}

<p class="fl-facts">required · number</p>

**This entry's share of the weighted draw.**

Relative, not a percentage: an entry is picked with its weight divided by the total of all the weights in the list. Weights need not add to anything in particular.

#### `head_blocks` {#head_blocks}

<p class="fl-facts">required · weightedBlockList</p>

**The weighted blocks used for the last layer -- the tip.**

The tip is where the plant stops, which is either the height that was drawn or the first layer that has nowhere to continue.

Non-empty.

Sub-keys: the same as [`body_blocks`](#body_blocks) — [`block`](#body_blocks-block), [`weight`](#body_blocks-weight).

#### `age` {#age}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · range · absent: {0, 0}</p>

**An age value written into the head block, drawn once from this range.**

Only written when the range's top end is non-zero, and only onto a block type that carries a growing-plant age state. Values at or above the state's own limit are dropped rather than wrapped, so an over-wide range quietly loses the top of itself.

#### `allow_water` {#allow_water}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · boolean · absent: false</p>

**Lets the plant grow through water as well as air.**

It applies to the layers themselves, not to the look-ahead: the check for whether there is room to keep growing is always air-only, so a plant in water stops one layer sooner than you might expect.
